summary: __thiscall visibility/classification mask test. Loads this object's bitmask from this+0x38; if it is 0, returns TRUE unconditionally (pass-all). Otherwise returns TRUE only when every set bit of this+0x38 is also present in both the global mask dword_8B8E34 (0x008B8E34) and the target object's mask read from a2+132: (dword_8B8E34 & v2 & *(DWORD*)(a2+132)) == v2. Used as a visibility filter on the scene traversal path, called by ArithmeticComparison_9000 (0x004C9000).

local_names.this: object whose category/visibility mask at this+0x38 is being tested
local_names.a2: target object whose mask at a2+132 contributes to the permission check
local_names.v2: this object's mask value loaded from this+0x38 (this[14])

operations.description: Load v2 = this[14], the mask stored at this+0x38.
Guard: if v2 is zero, return TRUE (unconditional pass) without consulting the masks.
Compute (dword_8B8E34 & v2 & *(DWORD*)(a2+132)) and compare it for equality with v2.
Return TRUE when the intersection equals v2 (all mask bits satisfied), otherwise FALSE; v2 == 0 already returned TRUE above.
This function is used as a visibility/permission filter by caller ArithmeticComparison_9000 (0x004C9000) on the scene traversal path.
